subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA click identifiers be exposed as prompt context, plugin-hook metadata, persisted session metadata, or held until a Conversions API plugin owns retention?
rationale: The extraction is technically bounded, but `ctwa_clid` is an advertising click identifier and the issue asks for agent/session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
options.body: Expose typed CTWA metadata to an opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook for attribution workflows without putting the identifier into every agent prompt by default.

options.title: Per-Turn Untrusted Prompt Context
options.body: Expose CTWA fields only as fenced untrusted context for the current inbound turn, with no durable storage.

options.title: Persist Session Attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state after maintainers define retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
recommendation.body: Expose typed CTWA metadata to an opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook for attribution workflows without putting the identifier into every agent prompt by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily about structured prompt/session metadata visibility and retention boundaries, where their recent history is adjacent.
